demo.title: singit-x402-demo.sh
demo.code:
# Live catalog: 300+ models with per-model prices (free, no key)
curl -s https://ask.singitai.app/v1/models

# Free answer: no payment, no key (20 per visitor per day, up to 400 tokens)
curl -s https://ask.singitai.app/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"free/deepseek-v4.1-flash","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Explain x402 in one sentence."}],"max_tokens":120}'

# Paid quote: an unpaid POST returns HTTP 402 with the exact USDC ceiling
# (default model quoted $0.0015 on Base, $0.00201 on Solana, verified 2026-11-10)
curl -s -i -X POST https://ask.singitai.app/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"claude-opus-5.5","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Hello"}],"max_tokens":400}'

# Remote MCP server (v0.1.6): list the 16 tools, 8 free and 8 paid
curl -s -X POST https://app.singitai.app/mcp \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Accept: application/json, text/event-stream" \
  -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/list"}'

# Free MCP tool call, no key and no session needed
curl -s -X POST https://app.singitai.app/mcp \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Accept: application/json, text/event-stream" \
  -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":2,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"list_price_symbols","arguments":{}}}'

setup: Try free first: POST to https://ask.singitai.app/v1/chat/completions with any free/* model — no payment, no key, 20 answers per visitor per day
For paid chat: send the request unpaid, read the HTTP 402 USDC ceiling on Base or Solana, sign with an x402 wallet, retry — no account or API key needed
Remote MCP: point any MCP client at https://app.singitai.app/mcp — 16 tools, of which get_price, list_price_symbols, list_models and chat_free need no key
Paid MCP tools need a SingIt API key from the SingIt app; web_search and read_page need its search scope, the market data tools need its tools scope and a Base account
Before any paid call, check get_allowance or get_limits so the spend fits the owner-set per-request and daily caps
